superoptimizer.gui.title: SuperOptimizer
superoptimizer.gui.subtitle: Safe performance settings for 26.4
superoptimizer.desc.enabled: Master switch. Disables SuperOptimizer and its background tasks; Minecraft, Sodium and Iris remain independent.
superoptimizer.desc.entity: Skips entity render submission for fully invisible sections. It does not disable entity ticking or AI.
superoptimizer.desc.block_entity: Conservatively skips only allow-listed vanilla block entities when their section and neighbors are invisible.
superoptimizer.desc.pause_motion: Temporarily disables culling during significant camera motion to avoid pop-in.
superoptimizer.desc.workers: Number of SuperOptimizer background threads. More threads do not accelerate the GPU and can compete with world loading.
superoptimizer.desc.reserved: Logical CPU cores kept away from the worker pool. Higher reserve reduces contention risk.
superoptimizer.desc.iris_lock: If Iris is installed, SuperOptimizer culling is automatically disabled to avoid extra shader-pass conflicts.
superoptimizer.desc.entity_culling_lock: If Entity Culling is installed, the duplicate culling pass is disabled.
superoptimizer.desc.diagnostics: Culling counters and events are available in the log window.
superoptimizer.desc.file_logging: Also writes the ring buffer to config/superoptimizer.log without crashing on write errors.
superoptimizer.desc.shader_scan_async: Scans ZIP shaderpacks in the background.
superoptimizer.desc.save: Save the current config to config/superoptimizer.properties.
superoptimizer.desc.apply_return: Apply the profile and go back.
superoptimizer.desc.preset.microwave: Maximum performance among the implemented safe features: aggressive render culling and no unnecessary background logging.
superoptimizer.desc.preset.light: Light mode: entity culling, near-entity protection and minimal background load.
superoptimizer.desc.preset.balanced: Balanced mode: entity + conservative block-entity culling, camera protection and Iris safety.
superoptimizer.desc.preset.advanced: Advanced mode: more aggressive safe culling and a larger CPU budget for independent background tasks.
superoptimizer.logs.title: SuperOptimizer Logs
superoptimizer.shaders.title: Shaders
superoptimizer.shaders.iris_missing: Iris not found or not compatible with the current client.
superoptimizer.profile.note: Click a profile above to apply and save it immediately.
superoptimizer.desc.background: Allows independent background CPU tasks. It never moves the render thread to a worker.
superoptimizer.desc.skip_near: Near entities bypass culling because checking them costs more and is safer visually.
superoptimizer.desc.near_distance: Entities closer than this distance always render. 0 disables the protection radius.
superoptimizer.desc.clear_logs: Clear the built-in journal and superoptimizer.log.
superoptimizer.desc.reset_stats: Reset culling counters without changing settings.
superoptimizer.desc.shader_import: Adds a ZIP shaderpack to .minecraft/shaderpacks without modifying shader contents.
superoptimizer.desc.shader_folder: Open the shaderpacks folder, like Iris.
superoptimizer.desc.shader_refresh: Rescan the shaderpacks folder in the background.
superoptimizer.desc.shader_pack_row: Selecting a pack opens the official Iris selector when a compatible Iris is available.
superoptimizer.desc.directional: Skips render submission only for entities clearly behind the camera. AI and ticking are untouched.
superoptimizer.desc.shader_iris: Opens the real Iris shader selection screen through the public Iris API when a compatible Iris build is installed.
superoptimizer.desc.shader_toggle: Toggles shaders through the public Iris API. Enabled only when Iris is detected.
